org: Department of Biology, Indiana University Bloomington
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. 2027 dates are not posted yet. In 2026, accepted students were told in late April.
how_to_apply: Apply online. A parent or guardian must say they know. A counselor checks your classes and grades. You also need letters from a science teacher and a math teacher.
name: Jim Holland Research Initiative in STEM Education (RISE)
what_you_do: A two week camp where you stay on campus. It is for rising seniors. You hear research talks and do hands-on work with IU teachers. You also learn about college plans, money help and scholarships.
who_can_apply: High school juniors with a GPA of at least 3.2, not counting extra credit. You are taking or have taken science and math. You want a science career. Students from the other Holland programs go first.
pay_detail: $600 stipend after you finish the program. Accepted students also pay a $125 non-refundable registration fee.
notes: Housed in a campus dorm. In 2026, accepted students were told the week of April 20. Contact holland@iu.edu, 812-855-5179.
